```plato

// A time series with explicit, strictly increasing sample times. Times and
// Values are parallel arrays; values are in Unit.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unevenly_spaced_time_series)
type IrregularTimeSeries
    implements ITimeSampled
{
    Times: Array<Instant>;
    Values: Array<Number>;
    Unit: UnitOfMeasure;
}
```
